Full Stack Developer.description: Develops complete web applications across the frontend and backend, building user interfaces, APIs, server-side services, databases, and deployment workflows.

Backend Developer.description: Designs and develops server-side applications, REST APIs, backend services, database integrations, authentication systems, and scalable application logic.

Frontend Developer.description: Builds responsive and interactive web interfaces using modern frontend technologies, component-based frameworks, JavaScript, and web development tools.

DevOps Engineer.description: Automates software delivery and infrastructure operations, manages containers and orchestration platforms, maintains cloud environments, and builds reliable deployment pipelines.

Cloud Engineer.description: Designs, deploys, and manages cloud infrastructure and scalable applications using cloud platforms, networking, containers, infrastructure tools, and automation.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Builds and deploys machine learning systems, develops predictive models, processes datasets, evaluates models, and integrates machine learning solutions into production applications.

Data Scientist.description: Analyzes structured and unstructured data, performs statistical analysis, builds machine learning models, creates visualizations, and generates insights to support decisions.

AI Engineer.description: Develops artificial intelligence applications using machine learning and deep learning techniques, including natural language processing, model integration, deployment, and intelligent automation.
